result.topic_en: Riemann discusses transforming a system of equally branched algebraic functions on a surface T by rational substitution into two functions s, s' whose algebraic equation G(s,s')=0 has the lowest possible degree, and counts the double points of that equation.

methods.what: An algebraic function s' taking each value n' times on T, viewed as a function of s (which takes each value n times), satisfies an algebraic equation G(s,s')=0, which is a power of an irreducible polynomial
methods.quote: einer Gleichung von der Form $G(s^{n'}, s'^{n})=0$ [-...-] und es ist $G$ eine Potenz einer unzerfällbaren Function.

methods.what: If G is irreducible (first power), all single-valued functions on T are rational in s and s'
methods.quote:

methods.what: Method to minimize the degree of the equation: first choose s rational in (s,z) with minimal n, then s' with minimal n' such that s'-values do not split into groups of equal values
methods.quote:
zunächst für s einen rationalen Ausdruck $\mathfrak{G}(s,z)$ so bestimmen, dass [-...-] $n$ möglichst klein wird
und dann $s'=\mathfrak{G}(s,z)$ so, dass $n'$ möglichst klein wird

methods.what: Number of double points (cases where distinct places give the same pair (s,s')) equals (n-1)(n'-1)-p
